shows.title: Abbott Elementary
shows.overview: Dedicated teachers are brought together in a Philadelphia public school where they are determined to help their students succeed.

shows.title: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage
shows.overview: This sequel to Young Sheldon follows Georgie and Mandy as they raise their young family in Texas.

shows.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
shows.overview: Best friends Mordecai and Rigby work and live at a local park. Somehow, their mundane jobs always descend into surreal chaos, much to the annoyance of their boss and co-workers.

shows.title: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver
shows.overview: John Oliver hosts this 30-minute comedy series that takes a satirical look at the week in news, politics and current events.
shows.originalTitle: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver

shows.title: Rage (Furia)
shows.overview: Created by Félix Sabroso, this contemporary drama series follows five women as their worlds start to shatter and intersect – escalating to a moment of unequivocal fury. Season two introduces uptight streaming executive Raquel (Maribel Verdú), who must conceal her past to survive at an increasingly bewildering corporation; hard-partying cleaner Charo, whose relationship with her violent son pushes her into a desperate decision; Charo’s neighbor Patricia, who abandons her cancer treatment to follow a purported television “healer”; Carla, an aspiring actress trapped in a toxic relationship with a struggling musician; and Tina, who discovers her traumatic life story has been turned into a dramatized television series. A kaleidoscopic portrait of women who’ve been pushed to the edge, Rage Part 2 (Furia Parte 2) is a subversive, satiric meditation on confronting a system that turns intimacy, pain, and violence into spectacle.

shows.title: Youth
shows.overview: Youth follows a 50-year-old divorcee's search for sex and love whilst juggling caring for her ailing parents and parenting her should-be grown up son.

shows.title: GET JIRO
shows.overview: In a futuristic LA, mysterious sushi chef Jiro sets out on a quest for vengeance. Based on Anthony Bourdain and Joel Rose's hit graphic novel series.

shows.title: WAR
shows.overview: This high-stakes legal drama follows the lives of London's most powerful lawyers as they clash over a headline grabbing case.

shows.title: 1000-lb Sisters
shows.overview: Tipping the scales at over 1,000 pounds combined, the Slaton sisters try to lose enough weight to qualify for and undergo life-changing bariatric surgery and pursue their dreams.

shows.title: Blue Lights
shows.overview: In the dangerous and politically charged streets of Belfast, police recruits face immense pressure as they confront criminal gangs and divided communities.

shows.title: 4 Blocks Zero
shows.overview: Set in 1990s Berlin, this prequel to the Max Original series 4 Blocks explores the early years of the Hamady family. Having fled from Lebanon with his four children and mother-in-law, Malik Hamady (Rami Fadel Khalaf) attempts to provide a better life for his family in Germany but struggles to gain a foothold amid prejudice and the challenges of daily life. When his brother-in-law Ibrahim (Tariq Al-Saies) is released from prison after eight years and joins the rest of the family, his dangerous secret sets off a chain reaction. As Ibrahim is drawn deeper into the criminal underworld, the Hamadys' values are put to the ultimate test, jeopardizing their safety and everything they’ve worked towards to secure a new future.

shows.title: Lanterns
shows.overview: Following new recruit John Stewart and "Lantern" legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

shows.title: Paolo
shows.overview: Paolo lives a simple yet fulfilling life in a small provincial town, moving pianos by day and planning a wedding with his fiancée Winnie in his spare time. After a chance encounter, Paolo finds himself attending a campaign event for his former classmate Téophane Tolbiac, an ambitious and magnetic local politician on the rise. But what begins as a commitment to Téophane’s campaign soon spirals as Paolo’s world is upended by his all-consuming desire to be part of the hopeful mayor’s inner circle. A gritty and spellbinding thriller, Paolo is an unflinching look at how easily the lines can blur between admiration and obsession.

shows.title: Real Time with Bill Maher
shows.overview: Bill Maher hosts this live one-hour talk show that features a monologue, roundtable discussions and special guests.

shows.title: The Torment
shows.overview: A disgraced journalist returns to her hometown to investigate the disappearance of a friend.

shows.title: Captive
shows.overview: Carolina Kopelioff and Lorena Vega star in this series inspired by a real case that follows Clara, a devout young woman who enters a convent, never imagining that her spirit will be crushed by the abuses of Mother Superior Cecilia.

shows.title: High Value Target
shows.overview: A CIA officer seeks answers from former Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein in his search for weapons of mass destruction. In a series of exchanges, he is forced to confront the far-reaching consequences of the US invasion of Iraq and the ramifications that would reverberate around the world for decades to come.

shows.title: Corregidora: The Darkest Night in Mexican Soccer
shows.overview: An investigation into the 2022 riot at Corregidora Stadium and the events that led to the violent brawl between rival soccer fans.

shows.title: 1000-lb Roomies
shows.overview: Larger-than-life roommates Nesha and Jaz tackle life, love and losing weight as they bond over food and their shared love of Jaz's daughter, Nana.

shows.title: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story
shows.overview: When a New Orleans cop attempts to solve the mysterious murder of a pet cemetery owner, he discovers an eerie and brutal past that still haunts the community.
shows.originalTitle: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story
